headlines.text: It was 2023 when Darby Allin vs. Nick Wayne met in a Tournament Match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 6.53.

On this day in 2024, Brody King chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a real marker of consistency, facing Brody King vs. Malakai Black vs. Mansoor vs. Mason Madden, in the show-closing main event slot on Rampage, rated 7.15 ? a good, competitive contest in a hard-hitting tag team clash.

Turning the clock back to 2024: Bryan Danielson reached a real landmark moment: their 100th match in AEW, facing Castagnoli, PAC & Yuta vs. Young Bucks & Okada vs. The Young Bucks vs. Bryan Danielson vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Wheeler Yuta vs. PAC vs. Matthew Jackson vs. Nicholas Jackson vs. Kazuchika Okada vs. Jack Perry, setting the tone as the night's opener on Rampage, rated 7.49 ? a well-worked match.

secondaries.text: 2023 brought us this moment: Le Sex Gods stepped through the curtain for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.82.
Back on this day in 2024, Mark Briscoe vs. Lance Archer met in a Qualifying Match, setting the tone as the night's opener on Collision, rated 7.20 ? a solid showing.
On a Friday in 2024, back when Alex Reynolds was back in action after just under 5 months away, appearing on Rampage.
